flows.title: Add a contact
steps: Sign in, then in the Contacts menu select All contacts.
Click New contact and enter the contact's name.
Optionally select the Contact details and Addresses sections on the left and enter more details.
Click Save & close. The new contact shows in the All tab. Contacts are added one at a time this way.

flows.title: Find and open a report
steps: Sign in, then in the Reporting menu select All reports.
Optionally select the Custom, Drafts, Published, Filed with HMRC or Archived tab to see reports by status.
Browse the categories, or use the search field in the top right corner to search by report name, description, keyword, report group description or the user who prepared the report.
Click the report to open it. Selecting the star icon next to a report's name puts it under Favourites.

flows.title: Export contacts to a CSV file
steps: Sign in, then in the Contacts menu select the group of contacts to export, such as Customers.
At the top right corner of the screen, click the menu icon, then select Export.
The contacts download as a CSV file laid out like Xero's contact import template. The employees group cannot be exported.
